node.name: Summertime Fruit Salad
node.description: This simple fruit salad recipe is fresh and healthy! It features strawberries, peaches and blueberries with a little balsamic vinegar and basil. It's a delicious side dish or dessert (for dessert, you can serve it as is or add some whipped cream to make it more decadent). Recipe yields 6 side servings.
recipeIngredient: 1 pound strawberries, hulled and thinly sliced
3 medium peaches, thinly sliced (I peeled mine, but if you don’t mind the skin, you can leave it on)
1 heaping tablespoon fresh, chopped basil or mint

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium serving bowl, combine the strawberries, peaches, blueberries and basil. Drizzle the lemon juice, maple syrup and balsamic vinegar on top. Gently toss to combine.
Serve immediately, or chill for later. This salad is best enjoyed promptly, but will keep well for about 2 days in the refrigerator (pour off excess juices if necessary).

review.reviewBody:
I didn't know I could crave fruit salad. But I recently made this for a coworker's birthday, and holy cow. I didn't want to stop eating it.
I mixed the lemon/honey/balsamic vinegar together and kept it separate until morning, since I cut the fruit the night before. I would eat this over and over.
